operating_notes.text: Ammonia availability started improving, enabling gradual restart of Methylamines, Ethylamines, and derivatives after March 12 disruption.
DME plant at Unit-IV, Solapur, commissioned 20 May 2026 with 1,00,000 TPA capacity; initial focus on aerosol and heating-fuel applications.
BIS code allows DME blending with LPG up to 8% in India, versus up to 20% in Western markets; PESO approvals for filling and road transport still pending.
Existing DMC capacity of 15,000 MTPA and NMP production positioned for EV battery electrolyte solvents.
DME plant at Unit 4 expected to be commissioned in Q1 FY27.
India Ratings withdrew ratings on ₹195 Cr bank facilities following receipt of No Dues Certificates and zero outstanding bank exposure.
Installed capacity of Acetonitrile (ACN) Plant enhanced to 1,440 TPM at Unit-III Solapur from 24 September 2026.
DGFT Pune placed license 3111001781 on Denied Entity List on 13 August 2024 for export obligation violation; disclosed after SEBI query on 29 Sep 2026.
SEBI issued Warning cum Advisory Letter citing non-disclosure of DGFT Denied Entity List order (13 Aug 2024) and FDA Maharashtra strict warning on Propylene Glycol quality (10 Jan 2025).

timeline.summary: Balaji Amines began gradually restarting production of ammonia-based products following improvements in global ammonia supply.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹394.79 Cr (+11.9% YoY), net profit ₹64.77 Cr (+60.2% YoY).
Abhijeet Kothadiya, Director, uploaded Q4FY26 conference call audio recording on 18th May 2026 via company website.
2026-05-20: Commissioned India's first commercial-scale Dimethyl Ether plant, 1,00,000 TPA, at Unit-IV, Chincholi MIDC, Solapur.
Balaji Amines hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call on May 18, 2026, guiding for 20-30% volume growth in FY27.

Smt. Gaddam Sushila Raja Reddy Foundation, Nomula Saritha, Ande Prathap Reddy, Ande Srinivas Reddy, Ram Reddy Dundurapu, and promoter group declared no new encumbrances on Balaji Amines shares by April 1, 2026.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹455.93 Cr (+27.2% YoY), net profit ₹78.12 Cr (+113.9% YoY).
India Ratings withdrew its ratings on ₹195 Cr bank facilities after Balaji Amines cleared all bank exposures.
Commenced commercial production at enhanced Acetonitrile plant in Solapur, taking installed capacity to 1,440 TPM.
Disclosed DGFT order dated August 2024 placing export license 3111001781 on Denied Entity List following SEBI directive.
SEBI issued a Warning-cum-Advisory letter on 29 September 2026 to Balaji Amines over undisclosed DGFT and FDA Maharashtra regulatory actions.

status_history.evidence: EBITDA margin recovered to 23.87% in Q4FY26, up 696 bps YoY.
